record_title: Boundary-layer concentration of the sharp univariate moment-SOS certificate
provenance: Asymptotic analysis of the explicit sharp atomic moment certificate in arXiv:2609.20544v1, compared with the related exact Stengle certificate in arXiv:2512.19141 and established pseudo-moment literature.
limitations: The result concerns one explicit optimal truncated-moment certificate and does not establish uniqueness of the SDP optimizer, a general moment-SOS leakage theorem, or floating-point stability. Classical orthogonal-polynomial theory may contain equivalent component asymptotics in different notation.
